stories.title: Takeaways from NFL preseason Week 2: Quarterback, running back questions highlight night
stories.summary: NFL Nation reporters tackle the biggest looming roster questions coming off each NFL Week 2 preseason game.

stories.title: Kasten reassures fans that Dodgers 'not for sale'
stories.summary: Dodgers president Stan Kasten addressed online speculation about the team's future under owner Mark Walter, saying the team is not for sale.

stories.title: Sky's Cloud slams 'weird' fans throwing sex toys
stories.summary: The Sky's home game against the Valkyries was interrupted when multiple sex toys were thrown onto the court Friday night, prompting Chicago's Natasha Cloud to speak out against what she described as "weird" behavior.

stories.title: Broncos' Nix throws for TD in return from injury
stories.summary: Broncos quarterback Bo Nix, who underwent two offseason surgeries to repair a fractured right ankle, made his first preseason appearance Friday night, playing 14 snaps and finishing 6-of-9 passing for 76 yards and a touchdown.

stories.title: 4-time Pro Bowl RB Chubb announces retirement
stories.summary: Veteran running back Nick Chubb, a four-time Pro Bowl selection who most recently played for the Texans, announced his retirement Friday night.
